clientScopes.name: actions:write
clientScopes.description: Grants permission to perform write actions on standard-tier resources.

clientScopes.name: actions:destructive
clientScopes.description: Grants permission to perform destructive actions, subject to the policy's business-hours window.

clientScopes.name: actions:override
clientScopes.description: Grants permission to write to critical-tier resources. Optional scope: must be explicitly requested, not granted by default - the realm-level equivalent of least privilege.

clients.name: Demo Agent Service Account
clients.description: A sample agent identity for the docker-compose demo. Client-credentials grant only - no user ever logs in as this client, which mirrors how a real autonomous agent would authenticate.
